name: 5-wire
description: Dependencies for building the 5-wire FFGL plugin. GLEW is only needed on Windows and Linux; macOS uses the system OpenGL framework. Nothing points at this file from CMakeLists.txt — find_package(GLEW) succeeds because the vcpkg manifest put it there — so deleting it fails the Windows job at CONFIGURE time while every macOS build and every local build carries on passing.
